title: Commander Night
description: Find a table, play your favorite deck, and enjoy an evening of casual Commander with the local Magic community. Players of all experience levels are welcome, whether you’re testing a new build, returning to the format, or simply looking for a great group to play with. Come for a game or stay for the evening—unexpected alliances and unforgettable plays await.
shortDescription: Make Tuesday your new favorite night for multiplayer Magic at Kitsune Brewing Co.
location: Kitsune Brewing Co. — 3321 E Bell Rd Suite B-5, Phoenix, AZ 85032
